findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_tiktok_creator_profile_and_analytics, get_tiktok_video_comments_and_replies, get_tiktok_transcript_and_translate, get_tiktok_live_room_intelligence, get_tiktok_shop_video_factory_pack · Private data: decode_tiktok_snowflake, build_tiktok_shop_deeplink, analyze_short_video_hook_and_beats · Public sink: get_tiktok_creator_profile_and_analytics, get_tiktok_live_room_intelligence.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_tiktok_creator_profile_and_analytics, get_tiktok_video_comments_and_replies, get_tiktok_transcript_and_translate, get_tiktok_live_room_intelligence, get_tiktok_shop_video_factory_pack · Private data: decode_tiktok_snowflake, build_tiktok_shop_deeplink, analyze_short_video_hook_and_beats · Public sink: get_tiktok_creator_profile_and_analytics, get_tiktok_live_room_intelligence

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
